evaluation_recommendations: Report character/word accuracy on the manually specified target regions separately from target-selection performance. A transcript may read text accurately while selecting the wrong story or page furniture.

For full-frame OCR, report target recall and non-target text volume separately. Do not treat every readable sidebar, browser label, related story, timestamp, caption, or reply as desired fact-check text.
Compare OCR on original and preprocessed images using identical target text and boxes; allow for small box drift after perspective correction by mapping boxes back to original-image coordinates.

Treat the two Al Jazeera homepage views as correlated near-duplicates. The nine images are development samples, not independent validation; preprocessing choices made against them may overfit these scenes.
The homepage samples have ambiguous user intent. Keep their assumed dominant-card target out of any headline accuracy claim, or report results both with and without these two samples.
For the selected blue paragraph, count only that paragraph as the requested target. OCR of the page headline is useful context but is a target-selection miss if presented as the fact-check claim.
For the final X sample, preserve the visible truncation and measure it against the visible string only; hallucinated completion should be penalized separately from OCR character error.
